description: This file contains utility functions for parsing arguments, classifying test target files, and constructing test run plans for Vitest, a testing framework. It manages configuration selection based on test file types and project structure, and includes functions for generating command-line arguments and writing include patterns.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path string.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if a string contains glob pattern characters.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches test or spec file naming conventions.

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a valid path, glob, or test file pattern.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts a path argument to a repository-relative normalized pattern.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Creates an include pattern for test files based on a path argument.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a test target file into categories like 'e2e', 'extension', 'channel', etc., based on its path and name.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for running Vitest based on parameters.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine forwarded args, target test files, and watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Creates a list of test run plans, grouping targets by category and associating configurations.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Creates detailed specifications for each test run, including environment variables and include patterns.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes include patterns to a JSON file for Vitest to use.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Builds the final command-line arguments for Vitest based on input args.
